fields.statement: Verified commit 6e7b448d0. go test -trimpath -p 2 ./internal/api -run TestWatchdogPolicy: exit 0 (runaway keys subtest resolves defaults 400, 8<<30 bytes, 5m and project over machine; invalid-values subtest refuses runawayMemory=lots, runawayProcs=-1, runawayGrace=0 naming the key). env -u RHIZA_*/SHIP_*/REX_* go test -trimpath -p 2 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/watchdog-policy$': exit 0 (three keys listed at defaults for machine and project, runawayMemory 12G set via rhiza daemon set, 'lots' and '-- runawayProcs -1' refused naming the key). rhiza ship generate: exit 0, 0 changed files (docs/reference/config.md current). rhiza render: exit 0. make self-check: exit 0 from a clean detached worktree at the commit (in the run worktree it only failed on this verifier's own untracked actor entry).
